name: Dyn_World_IntegrateVelocities
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_ship_inputs. Outlined block of 00C5BB30 with the world in ESI and dt on the stack (no clean prologue; Ghidra shows unaff_ESI), body 00C41550-00C41AC8. First phase of one Dyn substep: walks the world body list at world+204h (sentinel world+208h, next at body+84h) and, for each body whose B+50h bit 4 is clear, does v += (M+50h)*dt*force (M+50h is the INVERSE mass), adds world gravity (world+04h..+0Ch) unless B+50h bit 2 is set, applies linear damping max(0,1-M[+B8h]*dt), rebuilds the world inverse inertia M+60h..+80h as sum_k Ik*(row_k (x) row_k) from M+54h..+5Ch and the body rows, does w += Iw^-1 * torque * dt, applies angular damping M+BCh, and finally, when the byte at M+B4h is set, rebuilds Iw^-1 keeping only the row-1 term (literal 0.0f multiplies on rows 0 and 2). docs/RIGID_BODY_INTEGRATION.md | Run-time evidence, packet cc_exe_2j (bsp_game.exe milestone 2j): run per unit per fixed simulation step in bsp_game.exe, 8960 times over the USN02 mission, in place of milestone 2i's explicit Euler stand-in. The hull body carries no force, no gravity and no damping there, because 00C37F40, 00C37E70, 00C37E00 and 00C37DE0 have no caller on the hull path and nothing pushes force onto the body, so the phase only rebuilds the world inverse inertia. docs/GAME_EXECUTABLE.md milestone 2j.

name: Dyn_World_Construct
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. world* __cdecl(world*, const DynWorldDescriptor*), body 00C41AD0..00C420DB; 00C42119 pushes the descriptor and 00C4211A the world. Its fifteen copies at 00C41AF2..00C41B4A are the whole of the descriptor's effect: world+00h=desc+00h the fixed substep (0.05f in the shipped game), +04h..+0Ch=desc+04h..+0Ch gravity (0,-10,0), +10h=desc+20h, +14h=desc+28h, +18h=desc+2Ch, +1Ch=desc+30h, +20h=desc+34h, +28h=desc+3Ch, +34h=desc+10h the int substep budget (1), +38h=desc+24h (10), +3Ch=desc+14h and +40h=desc+18h the sleep speed thresholds (both 0.0f), +44h=desc+1Ch the sleep countdown reload (20). The rest of the body builds the pools, the broad phase and the task lists and was not read. docs/DYN_WORLD_SETTINGS.md.

name: Dyn_Engine_CreateWorld
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. world* __thiscall(engine, const DynWorldDescriptor*), RET 4, body 00C420E0..00C421A3, SEH frame 00CC81B6. operator_new(0x48C) at 00C420F8, Dyn_World_Construct 00C41AD0 at 00C4211B, then the world is appended to the engine's vector at engine+00h/+04h/+08h. Its only caller is the game constructor 004DDB90 at 004DE1D3, with the engine from game+14h in ECX and a 40h-byte stack descriptor at ESP+1Ch; the returned world is stored at game+18h by 004DE1DB, which is the pointer 00875E06 loads each fixed step. docs/DYN_WORLD_SETTINGS.md.

name: Dyn_Body_InitFromDescriptor
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. void(body in EAX, const DynBodyDescriptor* in EDX), RET 0, body 00C43CA0..00C43E9C; the registers are set by its only caller at 00C5D8B5/00C5D8B7. The producer of every body and motion-state field, so it settles the 84h-byte descriptor layout: desc+00h -> M+B4h (00C43CC7), +04h -> M+50h as 1/mass with no zero guard (00C43DA1), +08h..+10h -> M+54h..+5Ch as 1/x or 0 when x<=0 (00C43E01..00C43E0A), +14h..+43h the 3x4 transform -> B+08h (00C43E4D) and M+84h (00C43CDE), +44h -> M+00h, +50h -> M+0Ch, +5Ch -> B+50h (00C43CB8), +60h -> M+B8h (00C43D79), +64h -> M+BCh (00C43D85), +68h -> M+18h, +6Ch -> M+1Ch, +70h -> B+68h, +74h -> B+6Ch. Also seeds B+54h with 14h at 00C43E57. docs/SHIP_HULL_BODY.md.

name: Dyn_World_SleepContactGroups
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. void(manager) with the manager at [ESP+14h] (00C4B555), body 00C4B550-00C4B60B, sole caller 00C5BB30 at 00C5C503 with manager = world+448h, under the profiler scope 'SleepGroups' (id 1Ch, 00C5C4CE). For each of the manager+8h groups it scans the group's manifold array (entry+0h, count entry+4h) and, when every contact has both bodies with B+50h & 3 set (static or asleep), sets B+50h bit 4 on both bodies of every contact in the group, which is the bit both integration phases test. Then it clears the whole group vector through the same outlined 00C3F410 CreateGroups opens with, so the groups do not survive the substep. docs/DYN_CONTACT_SOLVER.md

name: Dyn_World_CreateContactGroups
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. void(manager) with the manager pushed, body 00C4B610-00C4B9AA, sole caller 00C5BB30 at 00C5BBBE with manager = world+448h (world+448h holds the world back-pointer, set at 00C41B99). Profiler scope label 'CreateGroups' (00D79F24, id 16h) opens around it at 00C5BB83. Clears the group vector through the outlined 00C3F410, resets both group marks through 00C36AC0, then flood-fills the scene's manifold list into islands: a seed manifold has points (+0C8h), is unassigned (+0D4h == -1) and has at least one body whose B+50h & 3 is clear; the fill walks both bodies' manifold arrays (B+74h, count B+78h) skipping static bodies and bodies already marked (B+64h), appends each reached manifold to the current group through 00C36B60 and clears B+50h bits 1 and 4 on both bodies of every newly reached manifold. Returns the group count in world+450h and world+458h. docs/DYN_CONTACT_SOLVER.md

name: Dyn_World_FlushPendingBodyRemovals
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_dyn_step, read-only analysis. __fastcall void(world), body 00C4D980-00C4DA6?, callers 00C5C540 at 00C5C5FF and 004DA780 BSP_Game_TeardownSessionState. Drains the pending array at world+438h (count world+43Ch, zeroed at the end). Per body: when B+70h is non-zero it releases the proxy handle at B+60h through slot 1 of the vtable of [[B+00h]+444h]+0ACh (B+00h is the owning world), clears B+50h bit 3 and zeroes B+60h (00C4D9A9-00C4D9CC); destroys every node of the contact list at B+70h through that node's own vtable slot 1 with the argument 1; calls 00C43AA0 and 00C43C00; unlinks the body (prev B+80h, next B+84h) and pushes it onto the pool at world+4Ch when B+50h bit 0 is set and world+170h otherwise, decrementing that pool's count at +120h. The teardown caller is what fixes it as a removal flush rather than a step pass. docs/DYN_PHYSICS_SUBSTEP.md
